comment: The four min and max trim pots are read from the instrument in Jack.cpp:90-93 and are absent from process_params at Jack.cpp:112-128, which sends only the two assignments, the shift, the shift action and the keep flag; no other code in the plugin writes ccMin1, ccMax1, ccMin2 or ccMax2. So the four knobs are indicators in 2.0.3, not controls, and the module documentation at doc/jack.md describing them as choosing the minimum and maximum is wrong for this version. The maker also names both jack 2 knobs "Jack 1 minimum" and "Jack 1 maximum" in Jack.cpp:23-24, a copy-and-paste slip that leaves the jack 2 pots wearing the jack 1 tooltips.
